characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (Books/Films)
characters.summary: Fluffy is a massive three-headed dog kept as a guard beast by Rubeus Hagrid. He attacks intruders with brute physical force using all three heads and can be lulled into a deep sleep through music.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to music, which puts all three heads to sleep
limitations: Lacks intelligence beyond basic guard animal instincts

sources.supports: Fluffy's nature as a three-headed dog, guarding duties, and weakness to music.

feats.claim: Guarded the trapdoor leading to the Philosopher's Stone beneath Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

characters.continuity: Harry Potter series (Books/Films up to Deathly Hallows)
characters.summary: Fred Weasley is a skilled prankster, co-founder of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes, and a capable duellist who fights in the Second Wizarding War. He specializes in magical gadgets, defensive spells, and practical combat magic.
weaknesses: Human biological vulnerability to standard lethal curses and physical debris
limitations: Relies on standard human physical and magical stamina

sources.supports: Fred Weasley's magical abilities, Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes inventions, and participation in the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Fought alongside the Order of the Phoenix and Hogwarts defenders in multiple skirmishes.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought alongside Order members at the Department of Mysteries.

campaignTags.claim: Invented and utilized specialized magical items and practical joke devices for combat and distraction.

characters.continuity: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them film series
characters.summary: Gellert Grindelwald is a dark wizard of immense power, charisma, and duelling skill. He employs devastating arcane attacks, widespread pyrokinesis, and persuasive manipulation without relying solely on specialized items.
weaknesses: Prone to ideological arrogance and underestimating personal loyalties of opponents
limitations: Cannot easily overcome magical blood pacts without external breaking methods

sources.supports: Grindelwald's magical capabilities, mastery of dark arts, and use of blue fire spells.

feats.claim: Generated the Protego Diabólica ritual fire in Paris that required multiple skilled wizards to contain.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

notableResults.opponent: Aurors of MACUSA and the British Ministry of Magic
notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
notableResults.note: Overpowered numerous aurors during escape attempts.

campaignTags.claim: Creates and controls complex sentient blue flame rings that incinerate enemies and test loyalty.
Master dark wizard capable of wide-scale spellcasting.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows / Fantastic Beasts
characters.summary: Grindelwald wielding the Elder Wand possesses vastly amplified spellcasting potency, capable of overwhelming multiple opponents and shattering powerful protective enchantments with ease.

mechanisms: Enhanced Shield Charms powered by the Elder Wand

weaknesses: Vulnerable to disarming if the wand's master is defeated in direct combat
characters.formDifferences: Wields the Elder Wand, granting significantly heightened spell velocity, destructive output, and magical penetration compared to his standard wand use.

sources.supports: The power enhancement provided by the Elder Wand to its wielder.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter series (Books/Films up to Deathly Hallows)
characters.summary: George Weasley is a co-founder of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes and an experienced combatant in the Second Wizarding War. He fights using standard magical duelling techniques and specialized joke-shop inventions.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical injury and lost his left ear during the Battle of the Seven Potters

sources.supports: George Weasley's involvement in magical pranks, the Order of the Phoenix, and loss of his ear.

feats.claim: Fought as a member of the Order of the Phoenix and defended Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Injured by Severus Snape's Sectumsempra during the Battle of the Seven Potters.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes tactical magical devices and trick items created for Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (Books/Films)
characters.summary: Gilderoy Lockhart is a celebrity author and fraudulent wizard who relies almost entirely on the Memory Charm (Obliviate) to steal the achievements of others. In actual combat, he is exceptionally incompetent.
weaknesses: Utterly lacking in practical combat skills or defensive magic; easily disarmed or incapacitated
limitations: Fails at nearly all standard spells outside of memory modifications

sources.supports: Lockhart's reliance on Obliviate and incompetence in duelling.

feats.claim: Successfully wiped the memories of numerous accomplished wizards and witches over his career.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
notableResults.note: Backfired his own Memory Charm due to using a broken wand.

campaignTags.claim: Proficient in casting the Memory Charm (Obliviate).

characters.summary: Ginny Weasley is a formidable witch, skilled duellist, and member of Dumbledore's Army. She specializes in aggressive offensive hexes, Bat-Bogey Hexes, and proficient broomstick flight.

sources.supports: Ginny's duelling prowess, proficiency with the Bat-Bogey Hex, and Dumbledore's Army membership.

feats.claim: Fought in the Department of Mysteries battle and survived the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought alongside D.A. members against Death Eaters in the Ministry.

campaignTags.claim: Skilled witch capable of offensive curses, hexes, and defensive magic.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter series history and lore
characters.summary: Godric Gryffindor was one of the four legendary founders of Hogwarts, renowned as an elite duellist and swordsman. He combined master-level wandcraft with physical combat using enchanted weaponry.
weaknesses: Not established in accessible historical text
limitations: Subject to mortal mortality as a historical human wizard

sources.supports: Godric Gryffindor's status as a founder, duellist, and creator of his sword.

feats.claim: Co-founded Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and mastered goblin-made enchanted steel weaponry.

campaignTags.claim: One of the most powerful wizards of his era, proficient in all branches of magic.

characters.summary: Gregory Goyle is a Slytherin student and frequent enforcer for Draco Malfoy. He relies on brute physical intimidation, heavy-handed combat, and later learns dark arts including Fiendfyre.
weaknesses: Poor academic aptitude and low strategic intellect
limitations: Unable to control the Fiendfyre he summoned, leading to his own defeat

sources.supports: Goyle's role as Malfoy's henchman and casting of Fiendfyre in the Room of Requirement.

feats.claim: Cast Fiendfyre inside the Room of Requirement during the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Defeated in the Room of Requirement when his own Fiendfyre consumed him.

campaignTags.claim: Summoned and attempted to control destructive sentient dark fire (Fiendfyre).
Capable of casting advanced dark magic curses.

characters.summary: Griphook is a goblin of Gringotts Wizarding Bank. He is knowledgeable in goblin metallurgy, vault security, and underground navigation, though he fights with a goblin-made blade when necessary.
weaknesses: Lacks advanced wizarding magic or wand access
limitations: Cannot wield standard wizard wands effectively

sources.supports: Griphook's background as a Gringotts goblin and familiarity with magical vaults.

feats.claim: Navigated Gringotts security systems and helped break into Bellatrix Lestrange's vault.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
